description: BSM1 open-loop steady state (constant stabilisation influent, KLa 240/240/84 1/d) transcribed by hand from the BSM1 technical report, for scripts/verify_bsm1_truth.py. Values are filled by an author, never by a script; null means not yet transcribed.
source: Alex, J., Benedetti, L., Copp, J., Gernaey, K.V., Jeppsson, U., Nopens, I., Pons, M.-N., Rieger, L., Rosen, C., Steyer, J.P., Vanrolleghem, P., Winkler, S. (2008). Benchmark Simulation Model no. 1 (BSM1). Report LTH-IEA-7229, CODEN:LUTEDX/(TEIE-7229)/1-62/(2008), Dept. of Industrial Electrical Engineering and Automation, Lund University. Prepared by the IWA Taskgroup on Benchmarking of Control Strategies for WWTPs, April 2008. https://www2.iea.lth.se/publications/Reports/LTH-IEA-7229.pdf
units: g/m3 (COD or N as appropriate); S_ALK in mol HCO3-/m3
